note: Foreign claims of banks by nationality (domestic banks, consolidated, excl. domestic positions) on each counterparty country, end of Q4, billion USD. Ultimate-risk (guarantor) basis where the reporting country publishes it, otherwise immediate-counterparty basis (see basisByYear). Flow = bank home country -> borrower country; top 150 pairs per year. exports = total foreign claims by bank nationality (lent), imports = claims on the country summed over reporting bank systems (borrowed); both sum over country counterparties only, so regional and residual BIS aggregates are excluded. Only ~30 countries report, so 'imports' misses lending by non-reporting banking systems (e.g. China).
